cancelDialog.title: Cancel invoice {{number}}?
cancelDialog.description: This voids the invoice permanently — the payment link stops working and it can never be marked paid. This cannot be undone. To correct a mistake, raise a new invoice afterwards.

main.loadInvoiceError: Could not load invoice to edit
main.noLearnerHint: Select a learner to view their payment history.

voidPayment.actionTitle: Void this payment — use it when a payment was recorded by mistake

dialog.title: Void this {{amount}} payment?
dialog.description: Use this for a payment that was recorded by mistake. The amount goes back onto the learner's balance and installments, its invoice is cancelled, and it stops counting as collected. The payment stays in the history, marked as voided. This cannot be undone.

voidPayment.successToast: Payment voided — {{amount}} is back on the learner's balance

payment.removed: The payment record is removed for good.
payment.balance: If it still counts, the amount goes back onto the learner's balance and installments.
payment.invoice: The receipt invoice generated for it is deleted, and its number is freed for the next invoice.

invoice.removed: The invoice is removed for good.
invoice.balance: An unpaid bill stops counting towards the learner's balance.
invoice.number: Its invoice number is freed and given to the next invoice.

permanentDelete.auditLog: A record of the deletion is kept in the admin activity log.
